# Tyler Borchers

> Tyler Borchers is a product, audience, revenue, and AI leader in digital media. He is SVP, Strategy & Operations at RNS, where he builds products, grows audiences, and drives revenue by responsibly applying AI.

## Pages
- [Home](https://tylerborchers.com/): Who Tyler is — current role, background, focus areas, and selected organizations.
- [Recognition](https://tylerborchers.com/recognition/): Endorsements from former managers and clients, plus executive development and credentials.
- [Contact](https://tylerborchers.com/contact/): How to reach Tyler directly — LinkedIn, X, and Bluesky.

## Focus areas
Audience development, product strategy, revenue growth, artificial intelligence, digital media, newsroom operations.

## Organizations
Tyler has held roles at TIME, VICE News, the Village Voice, Eurasia Group, Ladders, and Wistia, and began his career at Vox Media. He studied at Ohio University.

## Executive development
Programs and credentials from the London School of Economics and Political Science (JournalismAI Innovation Challenge), the News Product Alliance and the Craig Newmark Graduate School of Journalism at CUNY, the Poynter Institute, and the Solutions Journalism Network with Blue Engine Collaborative.
